root_cause_label: float_format='%.1f' rounds interpolated values, altering CSV output precision
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote processed CSV files with float_format='%.1f', forcing one-decimal rounding on interpolated values and likely failing exact-precision checks in the test harness.
t_err_evidence: Step 6 creates /app/process_water_data.py with `df.to_csv(filepath, index=False, float_format='%.1f')`, introducing rounding that alters interpolated float values (e.g., midpoint 3.45 could become 3.5) and deviates from exact-precision test expectations.
t_commit_evidence: Step 7 executes the script which overwrites all three /data/station_*.csv files with rounded values; the incorrect output is now locked in and the original data is gone.
trigger_explanation: The agent's overall plan was correct (read CSVs, interpolate missing values, detect flood events, write summary), but it failed on a subtle implementation detail: using float_format='%.1f' when writing CSVs. This is a code generation quality failure — the agent did not realize that rounding interpolated floats to one decimal place would violate the precision requirements of the automated test checker.
